etsy_title: Bookkeeping Spreadsheet 2027, Self Employed Income Expense Tracker, Profit and Loss, Mileage Log, Quarterly Tax, Invoice Tracker
description:
Income, expenses, mileage, invoices and tax set-aside in one tidy file: see your real profit every month.

WHAT YOU GET
• Income log with platform and card fees taken off for a true net
• Expenses in 22 tax-style categories, business-use % and receipt check
• Mileage log: miles x your rate = deduction, added for you
• Invoice tracker with Due soon and Overdue flags
• Monthly profit & loss by category, all automatic
• Quarterly tax set-aside with due dates + dashboard and chart

INSIDE
Start Here guide, Dashboard, Setup (tax year, set-aside %, mileage rate, categories), Income (1,000 rows), Expenses (1,500 rows), Mileage (600 trips), Invoices (300), Profit & Loss (12 months), Quarterly Tax.

FILES
1 Excel file (.xlsx) that also works in Google Sheets (File > Import, or upload to Google Drive and open with Google Sheets). Works with Numbers on Mac with basic formatting.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Buy and download instantly from your Etsy Purchases page.
2. Open in Excel, or upload to Google Drive and open with Google Sheets.
3. Type your numbers in the yellow cells. Everything in green is calculated for you.

PLEASE NOTE
This is a DIGITAL DOWNLOAD. No physical item will be shipped. Colours may look slightly different on screen and in print.
For use in your own business. Please don't share or resell the file. Prices and fee rates in the examples are illustrations: type in your own. A record-keeping tool, not tax advice: set your own tax set-aside % and mileage rate with your accountant or tax office.
Designed by our small studio with the help of digital and AI tools; every page and formula was planned, checked and tested by us.
